BLUE TWILIGHT — violet-blue dusk settles through the canopy as the market's first lanterns flicker awake, amber warmth pooling against the deepening cool shadow between the roots.
DEEP LANTERN-LIT NIGHT — indigo overhead and root-shadows below, the whole bazaar strung with dew-lanterns and firefly-lights, warm amber pooling thick on the lane against the cool dark.
BOTTLED-GLOW — the brightest light here comes from the shelves: bottled starlight and caged wisps throwing blue-gold radiance across the merchant's hands and the leaning crowd's upturned faces.
MOONLIT — a low full moon silvers the great roots overhead while the stalls hold their amber warmth below, the market caught between silver sky-light and golden lantern-glow.
FOGGY NIGHT-MARKET — soft mist drifts between the stalls, every lantern haloed in diffuse amber, the far booths fading into cool blue haze at the lane's far end.
GOLDEN-HOUR OPENING — low honey-gold light angles through the trees as the market sets up, first stalls lit by raw sunlight alone, lanterns hung but not yet needed.
MISTY DAWN CLOSE — pale pink rises at the forest edge, a few lanterns still guttering amber, the last merchants folding cloth into cool blue early-morning quiet.
